the oct 5 sheet you forwarded lists:
• **Soul Return:** bring a spirit back from the Spirit Realm to revive someone.
• **Spirit Storm:** combine an illusion, a spirit and lightning to give a creature, weapon or object a physical body.
• **Copies of you:** several physical versions that can fight and use your abilities.
• **Spirit/body disruption:** temporarily leave a targets body almost unresponsive.
• **Staff battlefield:** temporarily bring a large illusion, like an army or structure, into reality through spirits and lightning.
• **Guardian form:** a spirit version of you remains guarding the Spirit Realm.

so the posted kit includes physical creations, not just images people can ignore.

as your sheet describes it:
• **Illusion:** makes something appear or seem to happen.
• **Spirit creation:** uses spirits to produce something that can physically interact with the world.

**Spirit Storm combines them:** the illusion supplies the form, then a spirit and lightning give it a physical body. an illusion of a wolf seems to be there; the spirit-created wolf can actually fight. dravens current animals/creatures limit is about that creation step, not everything you can portray as an illusion.
